Title: Code Review Culture
Detail_lesson: How has your team evolved its code review culture over time?
CustomInstruction: Name one review practice you adopted and one you dropped. Say what review is actually for in your team — catching defects, spreading knowledge, or gatekeeping.

Title: Architectural Decision Records
Detail_lesson: How does your team document and communicate architectural decisions?
CustomInstruction: Say where architectural decisions live and who reads them. If a new joiner could not find the reason behind your last big choice in ten minutes, say that instead.

Title: Testing Philosophy Evolution
Detail_lesson: How has your team's testing philosophy evolved?
CustomInstruction: Give your rough split across unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and the rule you use to decide something is not worth testing.

Title: CI/CD Pipeline Optimization
Detail_lesson: What innovations has your team implemented in CI/CD?
CustomInstruction: Give one before-and-after number: build minutes, failure rate, or time to production. Then say what it cost to get there.

Title: Technical Debt Management
Detail_lesson: How does your team identify, track, and pay down technical debt?
CustomInstruction: Describe how debt becomes visible to someone who does not read code. Name the last item you actually paid down and who approved the time.

Title: Monitoring and Observability
Detail_lesson: How has your team evolved its approach to monitoring and observability?
CustomInstruction: Name the last incident where your tooling could not answer the question you had, and what you added afterwards.

Title: Knowledge Sharing Practices
Detail_lesson: What practices has your team developed for effective knowledge sharing?
CustomInstruction: Name one thing that works asynchronously in your team and one that only works live. Say which you tried to move and failed.

Title: Developer Tool Building
Detail_lesson: How does your team decide when to build vs buy developer tools?
CustomInstruction: Give your build-versus-buy rule in one sentence, and one tool you regret building.

Title: Incident Response Evolution
Detail_lesson: How has your team's incident response process matured?
CustomInstruction: Describe what changed after one specific incident — a runbook, a rota, a default setting — and whether time-to-recovery actually moved.

Title: Performance Optimization
Detail_lesson: How does your team approach performance optimization?
CustomInstruction: Describe how you find the bottleneck before optimising, and one time you optimised the wrong thing.

Title: API Design Standards
Detail_lesson: How has your team developed and evolved API design standards?
CustomInstruction: Name one API rule everyone follows and one everyone quietly breaks. Say which of those is the standard's fault.

Title: Security Integration
Detail_lesson: How has your team integrated security into the development workflow?
CustomInstruction: Name one security control that runs automatically and one that still needs a human. Say what shifting left cost in delivery time.

Title: Remote Collaboration
Detail_lesson: How has your team adapted development practices for remote/hybrid work?
CustomInstruction: Name one practice that survived the move to remote and one that quietly died. Say which one you miss.

Title: Microservices Lessons
Detail_lesson: What lessons has your team learned from microservices adoption?
CustomInstruction: Name the service boundary you would draw differently now, what you gained, and what it cost in operations.

Title: Database Evolution
Detail_lesson: How has your team's approach to data management evolved?
CustomInstruction: Describe your last painful migration and what you do differently now. Say whether running more than one datastore has paid for itself.

Title: Code Ownership Models
Detail_lesson: How does your team balance code ownership with collective responsibility?
CustomInstruction: Say who gets paged when a service breaks at three in the morning, and whether that matches who owns the code.

Title: Developer Experience Metrics
Detail_lesson: What metrics does your team track for developer experience?
CustomInstruction: Name one developer-experience metric you track and one decision it changed. Metrics that never changed a decision are decoration.

Title: Innovation Time Results
Detail_lesson: How does your team's innovation time translate to production improvements?
CustomInstruction: Name one exploratory project that actually reached production and what carried it across. If none has, say what stops them.

Title: Dependency Management
Detail_lesson: How does your team manage external dependencies?
CustomInstruction: Describe your update policy and the last time it bit you. Say how long a critical patch takes to reach production today.

Title: Platform Engineering Impact
Detail_lesson: How has platform engineering improved your team's productivity?
CustomInstruction: Name one thing developers no longer have to do and roughly how much time that gave back. Then name what the platform made harder.
